extraction.Name: Birdie Biggins Penne
extraction.Recorded patent: it was sent to me by mail, but I do not remember the date
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Part of it, say in some 12 acres was divided into town lots and sold, the remainder except the 10 acres mention above was mortgaged and the mortgage foreclosed on it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: taxes for the years 1919, 1920 and 1921, the period before we plotted the land for lots, amounted to $661.81 and I feel that this expense would not have been incurred had the patent not been issued without my asking for it
extraction.NOTES: Has only 10 acres of allotment remaining with back taxes as encumbrance; approximately 12 acres divided into town lots and sold; remainder mortgaged and foreclosed; received about $11,500 for land sold; satisfied with amount received; four children depend on her for support; states she and her husband support them; signed receipt for patent when delivered; document sworn before W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 10, 1929
